dispute.claim_text: First day in Singapore. He said expressway is faster, I said okay. At the gantry he asked me to pay cash, I did. Then the bill also had the toll. I complained, and the platform said the driver 'has discretion on routes'. Fine, but I paid the toll twice for a route I didn't choose.

counterparty_statement.text: ECP is the normal airport route. It has ERP at that time, everyone knows. I told him about the cash because sometimes the app doesn't capture it. If the app also charged, refund him the app one.
